subject: general
question: What was the Indira Gandhi Canal Command Area previously called as?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan Canal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **canal **was **primarily designed **to **support irrigation **in the **Thar Desert region **of the **state of Rajasthan**. 
 
• The **Indira Gandhi Canal **project was **earlier **known as the **Rajasthan Canal Project**(RCP).
 
• **RCP **was **first conceived **on **29th October 1948**.
 
• The **origin **of the **canal is Harrike Barrage**.
 
• To **lift the water from the canal**, **seven lift canals have been constructed:-**
 
 
• ​Bikaner-Lunakaransar lift canal
 
• Gajner lift canal
 
• Kolayat lift canal
 
• Nohar-Saheve lift canal
 
• Pokharan lift canal
 
• Phalodi lift canal
 
• Bangarsar lift canal
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Narmada Canal**:

 
 
• The **Narmada Canal **is a **contour canal **in **Western India**.
 
• It **brings water **from the **Sardar Sarovar Dam **to the **state of Gujarat **and then **into Rajasthan state**.
 
• The **main canal **has a **length **of **532 kilometers**.
 
• It is the **second longest canal in India **and the **largest canal by water carrying capacity**.
 
 
 
• **Sirhind Canal**:
 
 
• The **Sirhind Canal **is a **large irrigation **canal that **carries water **from the **Sutlej River in Punjab state, India**.
 
• It is **one of the oldest **and **biggest irrigation works **in the **Indus river system.**
 
• It was **inaugurated **in **1882 CE**.
 
• The canal begins at **Ropar headworks **near **Ropar city **in the **Rupnagar district of Punjab.**
 
 
 
• **Yamuna Canal**:
 
 
• There are **four major canal **systems that **irrigate **the **agricultural land **of the State.
 
• **Western **and **Eastern Yamuna Canal**: It is the **oldest canal **of the state.
 
• It **emerges **from the **Tajewala barrage**, which is **located **on **Jagadhari-Paonta Sahib road**.
